aviation.text: There is an art, or rather, a knack to flying. The knack lies in learning how to throw yourself at the ground and miss.
aviation.author: Douglas Adams

aviation.text: It is possible to fly without motors, but not without knowledge and skill.
aviation.author: Wilbur Wright

aviation.text: More than anything else the sensation is one of perfect peace mingled with an excitement that strains every nerve to the utmost, if you can conceive of such a combination.
aviation.author: Wilbur Wright

aviation.text: If we worked on the assumption that what is accepted as true really is true, then there would be little hope for advance.
aviation.author: Orville Wright

aviation.text: The exhilaration of flying is too keen, the pleasure too great, for it to be neglected as a sport.
aviation.author: Orville Wright

aviation.text: Science, freedom, beauty, adventure: what more could you ask of life? Aviation combined all the elements I loved.
aviation.author: Charles Lindbergh

aviation.text: Life is like a landscape. You live in the midst of it but can describe it only from the vantage point of distance.
aviation.author: Charles Lindbergh

aviation.text: I don't believe in taking foolish chances, but nothing can be accomplished without taking any chance at all.
aviation.author: Charles Lindbergh

aviation.text: The most effective way to do it, is to do it.
aviation.author: Amelia Earhart

aviation.text: The more one does and sees and feels, the more one is able to do.
aviation.author: Amelia Earhart

aviation.text: Adventure is worthwhile in itself.
aviation.author: Amelia Earhart

aviation.text: Courage is the price that life exacts for granting peace.
aviation.author: Amelia Earhart

aviation.text: Please know I am quite aware of the hazards. I want to do it because I want to do it. Women must try to do things as men have tried.
aviation.author: Amelia Earhart

aviation.text: The air is the only place free from prejudice.
aviation.author: Bessie Coleman

aviation.text: Oh! I have slipped the surly bonds of Earth and danced the skies on laughter-silvered wings.
aviation.author: John Gillespie Magee Jr.

aviation.text: Put out my hand, and touched the face of God.
aviation.author: John Gillespie Magee Jr.

aviation.text: The air up there in the clouds is very pure and fine, bracing and delicious. And why shouldn't it be? It is the same the angels breathe.
aviation.author: Mark Twain

aviation.text: A bird is an instrument working according to mathematical law, which instrument it is within the capacity of man to reproduce with all its movements.
aviation.author: Leonardo da Vinci

aviation.text: Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.
aviation.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

aviation.text: The airplane has unveiled for us the true face of the earth.
aviation.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

aviation.text: What saves a man is to take a step. Then another step.
aviation.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

aviation.text: A map in the hands of a pilot is a testimony of a man's faith in other men.
aviation.author: Beryl Markham

aviation.text: To fly as fast as thought, to anywhere that is, you must begin by knowing that you have already arrived.
aviation.author: Richard Bach

aviation.text: Aeronautics was neither an industry nor a science. It was a miracle.
aviation.author: Igor Sikorsky

aviation.text: If you are in trouble anywhere in the world, an airplane can fly over and drop flowers, but a helicopter can land and save your life.
aviation.author: Igor Sikorsky

aviation.text: You do what you can for as long as you can, and when you finally can't, you do the next best thing. You back up but you don't give up.
aviation.author: Chuck Yeager

aviation.text: If you're faced with a forced landing, fly the thing as far into the crash as possible.
aviation.author: Bob Hoover

aviation.text: One way of looking at this might be that for 42 years, I've been making small, regular deposits in this bank of experience, education and training. And on January 15 the balance was sufficient so that I could make a very large withdrawal.
aviation.author: Chesley Sullenberger

aviation.text: From this day forward, Flight Control will be known by two words: Tough and Competent.
aviation.author: Gene Kranz

aviation.text: Houston, Tranquility Base here. The Eagle has landed.
aviation.author: Neil Armstrong

aviation.text: That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.
aviation.author: Neil Armstrong

aviation.text: Mystery creates wonder and wonder is the basis of man's desire to understand.
aviation.author: Neil Armstrong

aviation.text: I don't know what you could say about a day in which you have seen four beautiful sunsets.
aviation.author: John Glenn

aviation.text: All adventures, especially into new territory, are scary.
aviation.author: Sally Ride

aviation.text: Never be limited by other people's limited imaginations.
aviation.author: Mae Jemison

aviation.text: The Earth is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in the cradle forever.
aviation.author: Konstantin Tsiolkovsky

aviation.text: We choose to go to the Moon in this decade and do the other things, not because they are easy, but because they are hard.
aviation.author: John F. Kennedy

aviation.text: Aviate, navigate, communicate.
aviation.author: Aviation proverb

aviation.text: There are old pilots and there are bold pilots, but there are no old, bold pilots.
aviation.author: Aviation proverb

aviation.text: A superior pilot uses superior judgment to avoid situations that require the use of superior skill.
aviation.author: Aviation proverb

aviation.text: Takeoffs are optional. Landings are mandatory.
aviation.author: Aviation proverb

aviation.text: Plan the flight, and fly the plan.
aviation.author: Aviation proverb

aviation.text: Never let an airplane take you somewhere your brain didn't get to five minutes earlier.
aviation.author: Aviation proverb

aviation.text: The three most useless things to a pilot are the altitude above you, the runway behind you, and a tenth of a second ago.
aviation.author: Aviation proverb

aviation.text: Try to stay in the middle of the air. Do not go near the edges of it.
aviation.author: Aviation proverb

aviation.text: Speed is life. Altitude is life insurance.
aviation.author: Aviation proverb

motivational.text: Whether you think you can, or you think you can't, you're right.
motivational.author: Henry Ford

motivational.text: Do. Or do not. There is no try.
motivational.author: Yoda, The Empire Strikes Back

motivational.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
motivational.author: Steve Jobs

motivational.text: Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
motivational.author: Stewart Brand, Whole Earth Catalog

motivational.text: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
motivational.author: Thomas Edison

motivational.text: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
motivational.author: Wayne Gretzky

motivational.text: I can accept failure, everyone fails at something. But I can't accept not trying.
motivational.author: Michael Jordan

motivational.text: Talent wins games, but teamwork and intelligence win championships.
motivational.author: Michael Jordan

motivational.text: The best way out is always through.
motivational.author: Robert Frost

motivational.text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
motivational.author: Theodore Roosevelt

motivational.text: It is not the critic who counts. The credit belongs to the man who is actually in the arena.
motivational.author: Theodore Roosevelt

motivational.text: Nothing in the world is worth having or worth doing unless it means effort, pain, difficulty.
motivational.author: Theodore Roosevelt

motivational.text: Keep your eyes on the stars, and your feet on the ground.
motivational.author: Theodore Roosevelt

motivational.text: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
motivational.author: Samuel Beckett

motivational.text: Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.
motivational.author: Tim Notke

motivational.text: Champions keep playing until they get it right.
motivational.author: Billie Jean King

motivational.text: I am the master of my fate, I am the captain of my soul.
motivational.author: William Ernest Henley

motivational.text: You must do the thing you think you cannot do.
motivational.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

motivational.text: Well done is better than well said.
motivational.author: Benjamin Franklin

motivational.text: Either write something worth reading or do something worth writing.
motivational.author: Benjamin Franklin

motivational.text: Lost time is never found again.
motivational.author: Benjamin Franklin

motivational.text: Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
motivational.author: Arthur Ashe

motivational.text: Success is where preparation and opportunity meet.
motivational.author: Bobby Unser

motivational.text: The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today.
motivational.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

motivational.text: The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
motivational.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

motivational.text: Don't watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going.
motivational.author: Sam Levenson

motivational.text: Perfection is not attainable, but if we chase perfection we can catch excellence.
motivational.author: Vince Lombardi

motivational.text: Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
motivational.author: Jim Rohn

motivational.text: Motivation is what gets you started. Habit is what keeps you going.
motivational.author: Jim Rohn

motivational.text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
motivational.author: Japanese proverb

motivational.text: Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes courage is the quiet voice at the end of the day saying, I will try again tomorrow.
motivational.author: Mary Anne Radmacher

motivational.text: There are no shortcuts to any place worth going.
motivational.author: Beverly Sills

motivational.text: Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value.
motivational.author: Albert Einstein

motivational.text: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving.
motivational.author: Albert Einstein

motivational.text: Do one thing every day that scares you.
motivational.author: Mary Schmich

motivational.text: Make each day your masterpiece.
motivational.author: John Wooden

motivational.text: Be quick, but don't hurry.
motivational.author: John Wooden

motivational.text: It's not the will to win that matters; everyone has that. It's the will to prepare to win that matters.
motivational.author: Paul "Bear" Bryant

motivational.text: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
motivational.author: Oliver Goldsmith

motivational.text: Never give in, never give in, never, never, never, never; in nothing, great or small, large or petty, never give in except to convictions of honour and good sense.
motivational.author: Winston Churchill

motivational.text: Far better is it to dare mighty things, to win glorious triumphs, even though checkered by failure, than to rank with those poor spirits who neither enjoy much nor suffer much.
motivational.author: Theodore Roosevelt

motivational.text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
motivational.author: Alan Kay

wisdom.text: The unexamined life is not worth living.
wisdom.author: Socrates

wisdom.text: Know thyself.
wisdom.author: Delphic maxim

wisdom.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
wisdom.author: Seneca

wisdom.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
wisdom.author: Seneca

wisdom.text: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
wisdom.author: Seneca

wisdom.text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
wisdom.author: Marcus Aurelius

wisdom.text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
wisdom.author: Marcus Aurelius

wisdom.text: Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
wisdom.author: Marcus Aurelius

wisdom.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
wisdom.author: Epictetus

wisdom.text: Men are disturbed not by things, but by the views which they take of things.
wisdom.author: Epictetus

wisdom.text: No man ever steps in the same river twice.
wisdom.author: Heraclitus

wisdom.text: Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom.
wisdom.author: Laozi, Tao Te Ching

wisdom.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
wisdom.author: Laozi, Tao Te Ching

wisdom.text: To know what you know and to know what you do not know, that is true knowledge.
wisdom.author: Confucius, Analects

wisdom.text: In the beginner's mind there are many possibilities, but in the expert's there are few.
wisdom.author: Shunryu Suzuki

wisdom.text: If I have seen further it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.
wisdom.author: Isaac Newton

wisdom.text: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself, and you are the easiest person to fool.
wisdom.author: Richard Feynman

wisdom.text: Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
wisdom.author: Marie Curie

wisdom.text: The good life is one inspired by love and guided by knowledge.
wisdom.author: Bertrand Russell

wisdom.text: Not everything that is faced can be changed, but nothing can be changed until it is faced.
wisdom.author: James Baldwin

wisdom.text: Do not let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
wisdom.author: John Wooden

wisdom.text: Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it.
wisdom.author: George Santayana

wisdom.text: Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.
wisdom.author: Søren Kierkegaard

wisdom.text: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
wisdom.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

wisdom.text: When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.
wisdom.author: Viktor Frankl

wisdom.text: Happiness is not something ready made. It comes from your own actions.
wisdom.author: Dalai Lama

wisdom.text: Well begun is half done.
wisdom.author: Aristotle

wisdom.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
wisdom.author: Will Durant

wisdom.text: Philosophy begins in wonder.
wisdom.author: Plato, Theaetetus

wisdom.text: The perfect is the enemy of the good.
wisdom.author: Voltaire

wisdom.text: I think, therefore I am.
wisdom.author: René Descartes

wisdom.text: Imagination is more important than knowledge.
wisdom.author: Albert Einstein

wisdom.text: Look deep into nature, and then you will understand everything better.
wisdom.author: Albert Einstein

wisdom.text: The limits of my language mean the limits of my world.
wisdom.author: Ludwig Wittgenstein

wisdom.text: Whereof one cannot speak, thereof one must be silent.
wisdom.author: Ludwig Wittgenstein

wisdom.text: The fool doth think he is wise, but the wise man knows himself to be a fool.
wisdom.author: William Shakespeare, As You Like It

wisdom.text: There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so.
wisdom.author: William Shakespeare, Hamlet

wisdom.text: All that is gold does not glitter, not all those who wander are lost.
wisdom.author: J. R. R. Tolkien

wisdom.text: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.
wisdom.author: J. R. R. Tolkien

wisdom.text: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I, I took the one less traveled by, and that has made all the difference.
wisdom.author: Robert Frost

wisdom.text: In three words I can sum up everything I've learned about life: it goes on.
wisdom.author: Robert Frost

wisdom.text: The mind is not a vessel to be filled, but a fire to be kindled.
wisdom.author: Plutarch

wisdom.text: It is only with the heart that one can see rightly; what is essential is invisible to the eye.
wisdom.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, The Little Prince

wisdom.text: Measure twice, cut once.
wisdom.author: Proverb
